faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

integration.question: How does it integrate with my store?
integration.answer: We integrate with all popular platforms: Shopify, WooCommerce, Zid, Salla, and others. Setup takes only 5 minutes via a simple Webhook.

whatsapp.question: Do I need a special WhatsApp number?
whatsapp.answer: Yes, you need a WhatsApp Business number. We help you with setup and connecting to WhatsApp Business API completely.

arabic.question: Does the bot understand Arabic well?
arabic.answer: Yes! The bot is specially trained on Egyptian dialect and Modern Standard Arabic. It understands different replies like 'tamam', 'mashi', 'mowafek', 'la shukran' and others.

pricing.question: What happens if I exceed the confirmation limit?
pricing.answer: In the Professional plan, each additional confirmation is only 0.70 EGP. In the Starter plan, you can upgrade anytime.

whatsapp_api.question: Do I need an expensive WhatsApp Business API?
whatsapp_api.answer: Akeed offers you easy and affordable integration options, whether you want to use your own number or benefit from our solutions.

unconfirmed_order.question: What if the customer doesn't confirm the order or send their location?
unconfirmed_order.answer: Akeed immediately marks the order as 'Unconfirmed' in your store, so you don't ship it and save your money.

easy_integration.question: Is integration with my store difficult?
easy_integration.answer: Not at all! Akeed provides you with a simple step-by-step video guide to connect your store in less than a minute. It's just an API Key or a simple plugin.

customize_messages.question: Can I customize Akeed's messages and language?
customize_messages.answer: Absolutely, you can choose the dialect that fits your brand (colloquial, formal, Franco) and edit the messages as you like.
